      public MotorComponent motorComponent(String name, MotorIOConfiguration leader, MotorIOConfiguration... followers)
      Builds a MotorComponent and registers it with this subsystem.

    • positionComponent

      public PositionComponent positionComponent(String name, double threshold, double debounceTime, MotorIOConfiguration leader, MotorIOConfiguration... followers)
      Builds a PositionComponent and registers it with this subsystem.
      Parameters:
      name - unique name used as the AdvantageKit logging key under "mechanisms/"
      threshold - angular tolerance used to determine whether the component is at a target position
      debounceTime - how long (in seconds) the component must continuously be within threshold before the at-position check returns true
      leader - configuration used to build the hardware interface for this motor
      followers - configurations for hardware interfaces driven with the same control request as the leader; may be omitted for a single-motor mechanism
      Returns:
      the newly created and registered PositionComponent

    • turret

      public Turret turret(String name, double threshold, double debounceTime, EncoderIOConfiguration encoderOneConf, EncoderIOConfiguration encoderTwoConf, Range range, double tolerance, int turretToothCount, DriveState driveState, Pose3d turretOffset, MotorIOConfiguration leader)
      Builds a Turret and registers it with this subsystem.
      Parameters:
      name - unique name used as the AdvantageKit logging key under "mechanisms/"
      threshold - angular tolerance used to determine whether the turret is at a target position
      debounceTime - how long (in seconds) the turret must continuously be within threshold before the at-position check returns true
      encoderOneConf - configuration for the encoder on the first reduction gear; its sim implementation is driven off the turret's own rotation automatically
      encoderTwoConf - configuration for the encoder on the second reduction gear; must have a different tooth count than encoder one for the CRT solve to be unique
      range - minimum and maximum angle the turret can rotate to
      tolerance - how close (in rotations) a CRT candidate must be to encoder two's reading to be accepted; size to the encoders' combined noise
      turretToothCount - tooth count of the gear fixed to the turret that both encoder gears mesh with
      driveState - suppliers of the robot's field-relative chassis speeds and pose
      turretOffset - pose of the turret's rotation axis relative to the robot origin
      leader - configuration used to build the hardware interface for the turret motor
      Returns:
      the newly created and registered Turret

    • flywheel

      public Flywheel flywheel(String name, double threshold, double bangbangThreshold, double debounceTime, Setpoint.Mode mode, MotorIOConfiguration leader, MotorIOConfiguration... followers)
      Builds a Flywheel and registers it with this subsystem.
      Parameters:
      name - unique name used as the AdvantageKit logging key under "mechanisms/"
      threshold - velocity tolerance used to determine whether the shooter is at a target speed
      bangbangThreshold - velocity tolerance used to decide when to switch from open-loop spin-up to closed-loop velocity holding
      debounceTime - how long (in seconds) the shooter must continuously be within threshold before the at-velocity check returns true
      mode - control mode used to hold velocity once the wheel is at speed
      leader - configuration used to build the hardware interface for this motor
      followers - configurations for hardware interfaces driven with the same control request as the leader; may be omitted for a single-motor shooter
      Returns:
      the newly created and registered Flywheel
